clips.title: The story
paras: Secure the Mountain is a scouting report delivered on behalf of Mountaineer Gretchen to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. After an expedition into a nearby cave proves catastrophic, Gretchen determines the cavern is a lost cause and refuses to send any more scouts into the overrun death trap. The mission highlights the ongoing struggle of Ironforge's mountaineers to keep Dun Morogh safe amidst rising threats.

Stationed out in the freezing peaks of Dun Morogh, Mountaineer Gretchen stands watch with orders to ensure the high passes remain safe. However, a recent foray into a nearby cavern reveals that the wilderness is far from pacified. Having assessed the situation, Gretchen concludes that the cave has become a complete death trap, overrun by hostile mongrels. Rather than risk further lives, she remains at her post on the slopes, determined to hold the line while dispatching an emissary to deliver her written assessment.

In the bustling settlement of Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard tracks the numerous dangers encroaching on the dwarven heartland. Upon receiving Gretchen's grim assessment, Whitebeard shows little surprise at the news that the cavern is completely overrun. Resigned to the grim reality facing Dun Morogh, he quietly folds Gretchen's letter into his growing stack of field reports. The intelligence serves as another sobering piece of documentation in Ironforge's broader effort to catalog and manage the volatile frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.
From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.
Feel free tae pass along the message, friend. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, you're back just in time.
What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.
Well, that's going in the report too.
